angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 347,850 km at 79.70 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 12.5465 +/- 0.0139 mas (same row, RUWE 1.15): 79.70 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.5 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Powers et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-3785 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...44P/abstract): 347,850 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.52 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Powers et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-3785 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...44P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3576 +/- 88 K from Powers et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-3785 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...44P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Powers et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-3785 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...44P/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-3785.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.756, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3785 (pscomppars): spectral type M2 V, from Powers et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...44P/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3785 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.099 dex, from Powers et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...44P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3785 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.43533, from Powers et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...44P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3785 (pscomppars): age 8 Gyr, from Powers et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...44P/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-3785 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Powers et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...44P/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
